selected.description: The source from which the emergency calling line ID (CLID) is selected for an actual emergency call.

locationMemberId.description: Member ID of person/workspace/virtual line/hunt group within the location. Required when `selected` is `LOCATION_MEMBER_NUMBER`.

elinEnabled.description: Indicates whether this workspace is allowed to use an Emergency Location Identification Number (ELIN) for emergency calls made from one of its devices.
